findings.claim: lint is sound against false negatives for REPL imports spelled differently
findings.fix: line_references_repl processes line-by-line and requires both 'runtime::{' and 'Repl' on the same line. It misses multi-line imports like 'use ruchy::runtime::{\n    Repl\n};' and glob imports.

findings.claim: lint is sound against false positives for bare .assert() legitimately consumed
findings.fix: is_bare_assert_statement flags 'return cmd.assert();' because it ends with '.assert();' and lacks 'let' or '=', falsely rejecting a legitimately consumed value.

findings.claim: lint is sound against false positives for a Repl reference in a comment or string
findings.fix: line_references_repl checks for 'runtime::Repl' without stripping comments, causing mentions like '// runtime::Repl' to falsely trigger the feature gate requirement.

findings.claim: adds item-level gates to six tests in tests/probar_wasm_modules.rs
findings.fix: Update the commit message or PR description; there are 7 item-level gates, not 6.

findings.claim: declaring required-features on the ruchy binary breaks documented workflows
findings.fix: It does not break any workflows. cargo install is used without --no-default-features in README and Makefile. Makefile targets that use --no-default-features also pass --lib (skipping the binary) or use wasm-pack which builds cdylib.
